tips.title: Judging Oil Temperature and Converting Common Temperatures and Units
tips.description: Learn to estimate cooking oil temperature, interpret the traditional ten-level temperature scale, and use a Celsius-to-Fahrenheit reference table.

tips.title: Making Caramel Coloring
tips.description: Step-by-step water and oil methods for making caramel coloring, with a reference table explaining sugar syrup stages and their uses.

tips.title: Tips for Using Aromatics and Seasonings
tips.description: Learn when to add ginger, scallions, garlic, chilies, and dried spices, plus guidelines for adding and measuring salt.

tips.title: Cooking Terminology
tips.description: A detailed glossary of Chinese cooking techniques, preparation methods, oil temperatures, sauces, and stocks, including regional and historical terms.

tips.title: Reducing Fishy and Gamey Odors
tips.description: Explore seasonings, dipping sauces, aromatic oil, and cold-water blanching as ways to reduce strong odors while preserving flavor.

tips.title: Cold Tossed Dishes
tips.description: A complete guide to preparing cold tossed dishes, from selecting containers and processing ingredients to mixing, serving, and safety precautions.

tips.title: Stir-Frying and Pan-Frying
tips.description: Learn pan selection, techniques to reduce sticking, basic frying steps, and precautions for hot oil, water, and grease fires.

tips.title: Blanching
tips.description: Learn hot-water and cold-water blanching methods, with specific instructions for vegetables and meat and notes on cooling and draining.

tips.title: Boiling
tips.description: Follow the basic boiling process and learn how to manage lids, heat, and ingredients to prevent a pot from boiling over.

tips.title: Learning Knife Skills
tips.description: A comprehensive beginner's guide to kitchen knife safety, grips, cutting techniques, ingredient preparation, cleaning, sharpening, and first aid.

tips.title: Marinating Meat
tips.description: Learn marinating techniques, containers, timing, and common ingredients, with general formulas and detailed examples for beef, chicken, and fish.

tips.title: Steaming
tips.description: Learn how to steam food in a layered steamer or a wok with a rack, including water-level checks and other practical precautions.

tips.title: Using a Microwave
tips.description: An introduction to microwave operation, cooking tasks for different power levels, and precautions for foods, containers, and hot steam.

tips.title: Using an Air Fryer
tips.description: Learn how an air fryer works, follow basic operating steps, and consult cooking temperatures, times, and preparation tips for common foods.

tips.title: Food Safety
tips.description: Read about food poisoning risks, allergens, bacteria, toxins, parasites, cooking temperatures, and food and medication interactions.

tips.title: Steaming Rice and Stewing with Rice Cookers and Pressure Cookers
tips.description: Learn the principles and benefits of pressure cooking, operating steps, pressure-release procedures, and precautions for valves, seals, and fill levels.

tips.title: Getting Your Kitchen Ready
tips.description: Prepare kitchen equipment and pantry staples, then learn about fatty acids and choosing oils for stir-frying, frying, cold dishes, and low-heat cooking.

tips.title: How to Wash Dishes
tips.description: A complete dishwashing guide covering sorting, soaking, washing, rinsing, drying, storage, appliance cleaning, and common mistakes.

tips.title: How to Decide What to Eat
tips.description: Use a simple formula to choose the number of meat and vegetable dishes, then consider guest preferences, variety, and signature dishes.
